keyPhrases.text: always delightful to hear the composer's idiosyncratic voice onstage
dramaturgical flaws inherent in the piece don't go unnoticed
songwriting is the real reason to see this show
book regularly seems too flimsily constructed
last 30 minutes feel especially rushed and dramatically half-considered
confused detachment than the devastating catharsis
all of whom really know how to deliver this material

reasoning: Mixed review with significant praise for Finn's songwriting and cast performances, but substantial criticism of the book's construction, tonal shifts, and dramatically unsatisfying conclusion. The reviewer acknowledges what works while clearly identifying major structural flaws.
